messages:
emily (support): FYI escalation from ACME: function-calling requests failing in prod with schema validation errors. Customer sees 400s since ~09:12 UTC. request_id=8f3a2b7c
marco (eng-runtime): Can you paste a failing request/response and a request_id? also which model/variant and whether they hit our gateway or dedicated infra.
emily (support): request_id=8f3a2b7c (same). Model: gptx-4f-infer-2026. They go through hosted API (gateway). Log snippet: 
```
2026-03-15T09:12:45Z ERROR validation failed: missing required property 'customer_addr'
req=8f3a2b7c route=/v1/responses tool=order_lookup status=400
```
emily (support): Customer says this started after a client SDK bump last night v1.9.2 -> v1.9.3. They included raw payload: 
```
{"input":"lookup order","tools":[{"name":"order_lookup","arguments":{"order_id":"A123","customer_addr":null}}]}
```
simone (oncall): null for customer_addr could be the problem. Our schema validator rejects explicit nulls for string fields. But SDK change might now serialize absent/undefined as null. @marco any recent validator strictness change?
marco (eng-runtime): We tightened JSON Schema in checkout of PR #3421 on 2026-03-14 to disallow null on many required string props because it masked bugs. That will 400 if `customer_addr` is present but null. Before it accepted null and coerced to empty string.
marco (eng-runtime): deployment of that PR rolled out to hosted gateway at 2026-03-14T22:00 UTC. It affects function argument validation in the gateway layer.
emily (support): Customer says they didn't change the app, only bumped SDK; SDK probably sends null for empty address field now. They need immediate mitigation.
deploy-bot: deploy noticed: PR #3421 -> gateway-validation-strict rolled to canary at 2026-03-14T22:00:21Z. Canary: 5% traffic, ramped to 100% 2026-03-14T22:47:09Z.
marco (eng-runtime): Short-term mitigation options: 1) revert validator relaxation (risky), 2) make gateway coerce null->"" for string typed args only, 3) add a per-customer feature flag to disable strict validation. I favor option 2 as minimal blast radius.
alyssa (support): I'm with option 2 — we can patch gateway fast. Customer asks for a fix in next 2 hours. They are experiencing failures in production.
simone (oncall): I'll open an incident page and mark P1-esc. Ticket INC-5421 created.
simone (oncall): Repro steps I used locally: 
1) curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"lookup","tools":[{"name":"order_lookup","arguments":{"order_id":"A123","customer_addr":null}}]}'
2) gateway returns 400 with body: `{"error":"validation failed","details":"missing required property 'customer_addr'"}`
marco (eng-runtime): Patch I propose (gateway): before schema validation, run small normalizer that replaces any string-typed schema properties with null -> empty string only inside `tools[*].arguments`. Will push to staging.
emily (support): Customer agreed to test a gated fix on their org if we can deploy to a subset. They can route traffic via a shadow header.
marco (eng-runtime): I'll open PR for the coercion hotfix, add unit tests and a toggle env var `COERCE_NULL_TOOL_ARGS=true`. If QA green I'll ship to canary.
simone (oncall): Is there any risk of changing semantics? Could empty string differ from previously-expected null? Document it to customers.
marco (eng-runtime): Good question. For our official tool signatures we treat empty string as empty; null was previously accepted but ambiguous. We'll only coerce for string schema types and only for requests passing through `tools` call shapes. We will add logs when coercion occurs.
alyssa (support): Logged customer impact: ACME orderflow failing; estimated ~220 failed requests / min. Their SLO degraded. They're asking for credit if it lasts >1h.
emily (support): Posting a sample of the gateway validation trace (redacted): 
```
TRACE req=8f3a2b7c validate start
schema=/schemas/tool-args-v2.json
found property customer_addr -> null but schema type=string required
validation fail -> 400
```
marco (eng-runtime): PR opened: #3498 "gateway: coerce null->'' for tool string args (hotfix)" targeting canary. I'll request fast-track.
deploy-bot: PR #3498 passes CI (unit + integration). Canary deploy scheduled at 2026-03-15T09:30Z.
marco (eng-runtime): Canary results: no regressions for 30m, no elevated errors. Rolling to 100% now.
simone (oncall): After canary rollout, ACME reported success and failures dropped to ~0 in their org. Emily confirm?
emily (support): Confirmed with ACME: failures stopped post-deploy. They tested with the same payload that failed earlier; now returns 200 and tool executed. They will continue monitor.
alyssa (support): TL;DR root cause: schema strictness + SDK now sending explicit nulls. Fix: gateway coercion hotfix + follow-up to docs + SDK patch.
emily (support): Follow-ups: 1) create SDK issue to stop serializing missing strings as null (SDK-2187). 2) Add telemetry and dashboard for `tool_arg_null_coercions`. 3) Email impacted customers with explanation and credit plan if needed.
marco (eng-runtime): I'll merge PR to main and create a release note for the change. Also adding a regression test hooking ABI: tool args roundtrip should accept empty/absent but not null unless schema allows null explicitly.
simone (oncall): Closing incident INC-5421 (monitoring). Reopen if ACME sees recurrence.
emily (support): Thanks team. Marking resolved for customer and sending postmortem summary. :white_check_mark:
